title: Six misconceptions about large language models: A minimal model and diagnostic taxonomy
abstract: arXiv:2608.20421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now embedded in scientific, educational, and governance workflows, with debates centering on their capabilities, mechanisms, and impacts. Yet these debates remain structured by persistent folk theories--intuitive, informal explanatory models that guide attitudes and actions. Deflationary slogans ("just autocomplete," "stochastic parrots," and "average of the internet") and anthropomorphic framings ("emergent agents" and "proto-minds") each capture genuine features of current systems but mistake those features for the whole. This Perspective proposes a minimal working model of LLM-based systems centered on four distinctions: between pretraining and deployed systems; between the learned distribution and particular samples; among parametric, contextual, and external memory; and between task competence and agency. The model is used to diagnose six misconceptions about LLMs: next-token prediction, regression

translated_title: 关于大型语言模型的六个误解：一个最小模型与诊断分类法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）现已嵌入科学、教育和治理工作流程中，相关辩论聚焦于它们的能力、机制和影响。然而，这些辩论仍受制于持续的民间理论——即引导态度和行动的直觉性、非正式解释模型。诸如“仅仅是自动补全”、“随机鹦鹉”和“互联网平均值”等贬低性口号，以及“涌现代理”和“原始心智”等拟人化框架，各自捕捉了当前系统的真实特征，但错误地将这些特征视为整体。本视角提出一个基于四个区分的最小工作模型：预训练与部署系统之间；学习分布与特定样本之间；参数化、上下文和外部记忆之间；以及任务能力与代理性之间。该模型用于诊断关于LLMs的六个误解：下一个词预测、回归至均值、记忆与泛化混淆、能力与意图混淆、静态与动态系统混淆，以及代理性误归因。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于四个关键区分的最小工作模型，系统诊断并澄清了关于大型语言模型的六个常见误解，强调区分预训练与部署、分布与样本、记忆类型以及能力与代理性，以纠正民间理论中的简化观点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a minimal working model based on four key distinctions to diagnose and clarify six common misconceptions about large language models, emphasizing the separation of pretraining and deployment, distribution and samples, memory types, and competence versus agency to correct oversimplified folk theories.
